#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

const int MOD = 998244353;

std::vector<int> multiply(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int needed = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < needed) size <<= 1;
    
    std::vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    std::vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    if (a == b) {
        std::copy(ar.begin(), ar.end(), br.begin());
        std::copy(ai.begin(), ai.end(), bi.begin());
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            long long val = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = val >> 15;
        }
    }
    
    // Perform FFT on both
    auto fft = [](std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while (j & bit) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            std::vector<double> cosines(half), sines(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cosines[i] = cos(i * angle);
                sines[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                    double ur = re[i + k];
                    double ui = im[i + k];
                    double vr = re[i + k + half] * cosines[k] - im[i + k + half] * sines[k];
                    double vi = re[i + k + half] * sines[k] + im[i + k + half] * cosines[k];
                    
                    re[i + k] = ur + vr;
                    im[i + k] = ui + vi;
                    re[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                    im[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };
    
    fft(ar, ai, false);
    fft(br, bi, false);
    
    std::vector<double> cr(size, 0.0), ci(size, 0.0);
    double factor = 0.25 / size;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double A1r = ar[i] + ar[j];
        double A1i = ai[i] - ai[j];
        double A2r = ai[i] + ai[j];
        double A2i = ar[j] - ar[i];
        
        double B1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * factor;
        double B1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * factor;
        double B2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * factor;
        double B2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * factor;
        
        cr[i] = A1r * B1r - A1i * B1i - A2r * B2i - A2i * B2r;
        ci[i] = A1r * B1i + A1i * B1r + A2r * B2r - A2i * B2i;
    }
    
    fft(cr, ci, true);
    
    std::vector<int> res(needed);
    for (int i = 0; i < needed; i++) {
        long long real = llround(cr[i]);
        long long imag = llround(ci[i]);
        res[i] = (int)((real + ((imag % mod) << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& in;
    
public:
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : in(stream) {}
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c, num = 0, sign = 1;
        do { c = in.get(); } while (c <= 32 && c != EOF);
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = in.get(); }
        while (c > 32 && c != EOF) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            num = num * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = in.get();
        }
        return num * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    
    std::vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        base[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }
    
    std::vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            ans = multiply(ans, base, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        base = multiply(base, base, MOD);
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    }
    
    std::cout << sum << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
